company.shortDescription: Dominion Dynamics is a defense technology company developing AI-native command, control, and intelligence systems for military applications.
company.description:
Dominion Dynamics is a defense technology company that develops AI-native command, control, and intelligence systems for military and dual-use applications. The company focuses on building interoperable sensing and command-and-control infrastructure for extreme operating environments, particularly the Arctic, by integrating commercial off-the-shelf sensors across land, sea, air, and space into a unified, sovereign intelligence network. Its mission is to strengthen national security by enabling real-time situational awareness and coordinated operations across multiple domains. Its core platform ingests and fuses data from diverse sensors into a single operational picture using edge AI for onboard processing, autonomous tasking, and local intelligence generation. Designed with a modular and interoperable architecture, the platform integrates with existing military command-and-control systems and allied defense networks, allowing operators to rapidly deploy and scale capabilities in contested or communications-limited environments.

A flagship application of the platform is AuraNet, a persistent Arctic sensing network that provides intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities in remote regions with limited or no cellular connectivity. The system supports both military and civilian missions by combining distributed sensors, autonomous assets, and map-based software into a resilient command layer for monitoring and securing Canada's northern territories.
